products.name: Dots
products.description: Personal agents from OpenAI that can work independently on delegated tasks.

events.label: Rollout announced
events.note: Rollout began for eligible Pro, Business Premium and Enterprise users.

products.name: Claude Duet
products.description: A proactive personal agent from Anthropic for work and everyday tasks.

events.label: Research preview announced
events.note: US Pro, Max and Ultra subscribers could join the waitlist; access was not generally available.

products.name: Muse
products.description: A personal AI agent from Meta for getting everyday tasks done.

events.label: Public introduction
events.note: Meta introduced Muse as a personal AI agent. This is the original publication date, not the later article update.

products.name: Grok
products.description: An AI assistant with access to information from the web and X.

events.label: Early beta announced
events.note: The official announcement offered limited US early access through a waitlist. This record covers Grok, not Grok Bot.

products.name: Dazzle
products.description: A personal agent guided through pictures.

events.label: Public launch
events.note: The announcement offered the app, web and text access.

products.name: Vellum
products.description: A personal assistant built around your context.

events.label: Hosted assistants launched
events.note: Release v0.6.0 introduced cloud-hosted assistants and made the assistant repository public. Earlier local releases exist.

events.label: Personal Intelligence introduction
events.note: A later public introduction; it does not replace the earlier hosted-service release date.

events.label: Hosted shutdown began
events.note: Cloud assistants began being exported and turned off. Self-hosted assistants can continue; this is not a company-wide shutdown.

products.name: Sesame
products.description: Voice agents for conversation, research, planning and everyday tasks.

events.label: Voice preview released
events.note: A public conversational voice demo, not the launch of every later Sesame product.

products.name: Letta
products.description: A personalized agent that remembers and learns.

events.label: Letta announced
events.note: Letta was introduced as the successor platform to MemGPT. Cloud access was an early pilot; MemGPT predates this announcement.

events.label: Family assistant launch announcement
events.note: Founder Bill Lennon introduced the family assistant publicly. Earlier users existed; this is a confirmed announcement, not a claim about its first-ever user.

events.label: Service sunset
events.note: The official farewell specifies this effective shutdown date and refunds for unused subscriptions.

products.name: OpenBot
products.description: A self-hostable AI coworker platform from CopilotKit, with tools, approvals, and shared workspaces.

events.label: OpenBot 1.0 launched
events.note: The official account announced Mac and Windows availability. Earlier Open-Dots, Muse and Duet projects are not counted as this release.
